pick.name: Exa MCP
pick.what: Neural web search + code-context search via hosted MCP
pick.why: Best free volume ($10 credit refreshed monthly = up to 2,500 Lite searches) and code-example search; official marketplace plugin
pick.free_limits: $10/month free credit, no card; Search $4-7 per 1k

best_free.name: Tavily
best_free.free_limits: Researcher: 1,000 API credits/month, no card; Project $30/mo for 4,000 credits; pay-as-you-go $0.008/credit
best_free.maintained: live; Nebius agreed to acquire Tavily (announced 2026-02-10); brand continues as 'Tavily by Nebius'

alts.name: Built-in WebSearch/WebFetch
alts.why: Zero setup; enough for most lookups
alts.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

alts.name: Brave Search API
alts.what: Independent web index API with MCP server
alts.free_limits: plans page did not show limits; unverified

decision: Built-in search stays the default; Exa is the add-on for code examples or bulk research and offers a recurring free credit. Check the current pricing page before relying on it.

verify.note: Verified: $10 free credit resets monthly, no payment method; $4/1k lite/instant, $7/1k auto/fast.
